content.value: In the Diffie-Hellman Key Exchange (DHKE) protocol, each participant selects a (11) [CO2] private key ‘a’ from the range $\{ 2 , \ldots , P { - } 2 \}$ where P is a prime number. Explain why the values a = 1 and $a = P - 1$ are excluded from this range.
